incident_summary: Public-facing EC2 web server observed beaconing to a known cryptocurrency mining pool after exploitation of a vulnerable web application.
root_cause: Unpatched web application vulnerability allowed remote code execution; attacker deployed a miner and persisted via a cron job.
actions_taken: Isolated instance via quarantine security group
Blocked outbound traffic to the mining pool IP
Revoked instance IAM role STS sessions
Rebuilt instance from a clean AMI
outcome: Contained within 40 minutes of detection; no data exfiltration observed; instance rebuilt and redeployed.
lessons_learned: GuardDuty CryptoCurrency findings should trigger immediate network isolation, not just alerting — the miner persisted via cron and would have survived a simple process kill. Always patch the initial access vector before returning the instance to service.
